question: Who among the following was the recipient of the ‘National Award for Young Women Showing Excellence through Application of Technology for Societal Benefit’ in March 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Shweta Rawat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr Shweta Rawat** from the Defence Institute of Physiology and Allied Sciences (DIPAS), DRDO was recently consulted with the **‘National Award** for Young Women Showing brilliance through Application of Technology for Societal Benefits’** by the President of India Ramnath Kovind.**
 
• **Dr Shweta** has made a female-specific Full Body protector.
 
• **Scientist Dr Shweta Rawat,** who guide the designing team, said **anthropometric data** were used to design the gears which make sure the defence of **vital organs of women.**
 
• “The gear is **anti-stab, anti-acid.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Ritu Karidhal Srivastava **is an Indian scientist working with the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). **
 
• **Gagandeep Kang FRS** is an Indian Microbiologist and virologist.
 
• ​**Muthayya Vanitha** is an Indian electronics system engineer who has guided projects on satellites at the Indian Space Research Organization.
